queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = '3Dconnexion 3DxWare 10' AND publisher = '3Dconnexion';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = '3Dconnexion 3DxWare 10' AND publisher = '3Dconnexion' AND version_compare(version, '10.9.15.753') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = '3dxhome.exe');
